scripts.serve: sh -c 'if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8003}; elif python3 -c "import uvicorn" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8003}; else echo "apply-agent: install uv or python3+uvicorn" >&2; exit 127; fi'
scripts.serve:prod: sh -c 'if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8003}; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8003}; fi'
scripts.start: sh -c 'if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8003}; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8003}; fi'
scripts.worker: sh -c 'if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --with-requirements requirements.txt celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2; elif python3 -c "import celery" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2; else echo "apply-agent: install uv or python3+celery" >&2; exit 127; fi'
